# Parser Stress Test Fixtures

Four real-world PDFs used to stress-test the ingestion parser.
These are committed for parser coverage only — not for training,
fine-tuning, or redistribution as content.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| two-column.pdf | Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition (ResNet), arXiv:1512.03385 | arXiv non-exclusive |
| math-heavy.pdf | NIST FIPS 197-upd1, Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) | Public Domain (US Gov) |
| table-heavy.pdf | Apple Inc. FY23 Form 10-K, SEC EDGAR | Public Domain (mandatory filing) |
| code-heavy.pdf | Think Python 2nd Edition, Allen Downey, Green Tea Press | CC BY-NC 3.0 |

Note: Think Python is CC BY-NC. Used here as a parser test fixture
under personal/non-commercial use. Swap for a CC-BY programming text
before any commercial redistribution of this repo.
